text_block_list.text:
—The Kikuka Sho. A battle for supremacy over 3,000 meters at Kyoto,
the final jewel of the Classic Triple Crown.
The first showdown against Mejiro McQueen arrived on the grandest stage of all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I've always kept
losing to McQueen. Always...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
In elegance, cuteness, and inner strength,
I was completely outmatched.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm glad I lost!
Because I was weak, I could respect you! I could chase after you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Because I truly felt that
"I want to defeat what seems unbeatable."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm glad that I'm just an ordinary person!
choice_data_list: Looks like you've moved past it.
Looks like you've moved past it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes. But I have no intention of leaving things half-done.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You are developing quite the presence, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To have brought things this far
is truly magnificent. However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I cannot lose.
The 3,000 meters is my greatest distance."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm going all out to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen, the Classics might not hold the same weight for you as the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm just so happy
that I get to run with you here!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That you, someone I respect so much, made it in time for the once-in-a-lifetime Classics!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you truly are simple-minded.
Yet... that very purity is what frightens me the most.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, beneath the chrysanthemums—
Our first serious showdown since the athletic meet!
